parameters.jsCode: function text(v){return String(v??'').trim();}const source=$('Code | Build Identity Registry Row | Registration').first().json;let rows=[];try{rows=$('Read | Identity Registry | Verify Principal | Registration').all().map(x=>x.json||{}).filter(r=>text(r.principalKey));}catch{}rows=rows.filter(r=>text(r.principalKey)===source.principalKey);if(rows.length!==1)throw new Error('identity registry exact read-back count mismatch');const row=rows[0];for(const key of ['storageUsername','userId','memoryUserId','tenantId','memoryTenantId','qdrantCollection','soulId','timeZone'])if(text(row[key])!==text(source.registryRow[key]))throw new Error(`identity registry ${key} mismatch`);return [{json:{...source,verifiedRegistryRow:row,registrationStage:'registry_verified'}}];
